body.label: Trigger
body.html: An Exposed enemy enters your weapon range or uses an Action that does not target you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Attack the triggering enemy. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage.

surges.html: After the triggering effect resolves, learn whether its source has any unused Reactions or maintained effects.
If the triggering enemy is Exposed or has a normal Condition, ignore 1 Defense for this attack.
